sentences.en: The candidate was disappointed at the outcome of the election.
sentences.zh: 这位候选人对选举结果感到失望。

sentences.en: The independent candidate took the abortion issue off his platform.
sentences.zh: 独立候选人把堕胎问题从自己的竞选纲领中拿掉了。

sentences.en: The candidate whom I cast a vote for was elected.
sentences.zh: 我投票支持的那位候选人当选了。

senses.zh: (可以获得某种结果、待遇或职务的)待选人(或物); 申请人, 求职申请人; 选举候选人; 考生, 报考者
